email.subject: PO-120 confirmation of split
email.text:
Dear purchasing,

We confirm the split for PO-120 (revision 3), line 10, KF-A-01: 40 EA delivered to your warehouse on 23 October 2026, then the remaining 80 EA delivered on 26 October 2026.

Kestrel Fasteners

expected.downstream: intake accept; a later stock change makes the approved plan stale and forces reassessment
